beats.headline: Super sparkly
beats.text: Before the achievements, Donut wants Mongo healed. A Heal Severe Injury potion Carl made while he was part spider has already mended his burns, but the wing is still missing. Donut pushes forward a Heal Pet potion that Carl put on the ground before the vinegar goddess lost her head to Paz; now it is super sparkly and calls itself Revitalize Pet. It is purple and looks as if someone dumped half a jar of glitter into it. Super rare, Mordecai says, and expensive, but with his newest table upgrade he can learn the recipe without ruining it. It will grow the wing back in about an hour, though there may be scars.

beats.headline: Glass on his bum
beats.text: Mongo looks at his missing right wing as if noticing it for the very first time, and Donut wants the potion now. Mordecai warns that it is expensive: he knows how to make them, but the ingredients are really rare. Donut tells Mongo to drink every drop and Carl to be gentle. Carl walks over and smashes the vial on Mongo's butt at the base of his tail. That was mean, Donut cries, but the Healing buff appears over Mongo's head. A potion thrown at someone else works, and for Mongo it is a lot safer than pouring it down his throat.
